analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth driven by volume expansion and the commencement of its new Marol manufacturing facility. Management expressed confidence in the long-term fundamentals of the gold and organized jewellery market, while outlining ongoing capital initiatives including a rights issue of up to INR100 crores and the upcoming Jaipur facility. The company maintained its annual growth guidance and discussed operational metrics such as capacity utilization, product mix, and working capital requirements. Shanti Gold International Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust financial performance with significant year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and net profit. The company reported a revenue from operations of Rs 716.4 Cr for Q1 FY27 and detailed its strategic capacity expansions including the Marol facility and upcoming Jaipur facility.

guidance.claim: The company sticks to its annual guidance of around 50% to 60% growth in top line value.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth to remain in the 30% to 40% range compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margin for the year is projected around 7.5% to 8%.
guidance.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

guidance.claim: Management expects around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60% to 70% growth in terms of value for the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the organized jewellery market remains constructive, supported by wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and a preference for organized and branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive. India's jewellery market is supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasable preference for organized and branded jewellery.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on gold over the long term with strong underlying fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish. The long-term fundamentals remain very strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy transactions, particularly in wedding and occasions-led jewellery categories.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust across both traditional and modern design formats.
demand_outlook.quote: While demand remained robust across both traditional and modern design formats.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex allotted for the Jaipur facility is around INR47 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur facility is expected to be operational around mid-November or December.
capex_expansion.quote: and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur continues to progress in line with expectations.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

capex_expansion.claim: Once operational, these capacity additions will take total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR716.38 crores compared to INR292.78 crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Coming to our financial performance during quarter 1 FY27, the company reported revenue from operations of INR716.38 crores compared to the INR292.78 crores in Q1 FY26, registering a growth of 144.69%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR71.45 crores with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for Q1 FY27 stood at INR50.48 crores compared to INR34.36 crores in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax stood at INR50.48 crores compared to INR34.36 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Roughly 2% to 2.5% of the reported EBITDA margin comprised unrealized inventory gains realized during the quarter due to a change in the inventory valuation method.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 10.9%.
EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 was reported at 10.0%.
PAT margin for Q1 FY27 was 7.1%.
EBITDA margins for Q4 FY26 stood at 10.17% compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter stood at 10.17% as compared to 7.10% in the corresponding period last year, improving by 306 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for FY26 stood at 9.86% as compared to 8.13% in FY25, improving by 173 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis points Y-o-Y.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margins for FY26 stood at 6.94% as compared to 4.89% in FY25, improving by 205 basis pointsY-o-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization for the Mumbai existing facility is at 75%.
The Jaipur facility is spread across 3 acres of land with an initial phase of 50,000 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity stands at approximately 6,700 kg per annum post commissioning of Andheri and Marol facilities.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: The existing Andheri manufacturing facility has an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing Andheri manufacturing facility with an installed capacity of approximately 2,700 kilo per annum has been operating at healthy utilization levels in line with the growth of our new Marol facility in Mumbai

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value INR10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt-to-equity ratio currently stands at 0.50.
capital_allocation.quote: See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: The funds acquired from the rights issue will be invested completely in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to maintain a disciplined approach towards working capital management, operational efficiency, and balance sheet strength while continuing to invest in future growth opportunities.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that there could be short-term jitters in the near term regarding gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we are hopeful that the gold will, maybe there could be a short-term jitters in the near-term, but going forward in the long-term, we expect a good rally in the gold market

risks_headwinds.claim: Incorporation timeline for the Dubai subsidiary has been extended due to geopolitical situations and ongoing wars.
risks_headwinds.quote: So due to all these wars and all, it is extended for a couple of months more ahead now because the situation, geopolitical things are not good.

management_commitments.claim: The company sticks to its annual top-line growth guidance of 50% to 60% and volume growth of 30% to 40% for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is expected to be operational around mid-November or December of this year.
management_commitments.quote: and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur factory is expected to start by around September or October.
management_commitments.quote: and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets around 30% to 40% growth in volume and 60% to 70% growth in value for the coming year.
management_commitments.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value
